title: Level 2: Android Platform Fundamentals
description: Understand Android projects, system-managed application components, lifecycle boundaries, resources, permissions, and hybrid Compose/View applications.
plannedTopics: Android Studio, SDKs, modules, Gradle, manifests, SDK levels, variants, APKs, and app bundles
Application process, Context, Activity lifecycle, configuration, saved state, and localised resources
Intents, results, permissions, components, services, broadcasts, providers, PendingIntent, tasks, and App Links
XML Views, ConstraintLayout, View Binding, fragments, RecyclerView, Compose interoperability, and the Notes capstone

project.title: Personal Notes Application
project.summary: Build a multi-screen notes app that survives lifecycle events, handles deep links, and includes a hybrid XML screen.

theme.mapMood: Platform districts connected by lifecycle and system boundaries.
